name: Stalwart Shieldmate's Floating Memory pays a champion level-up's memory cost from graveyard
notes: Stalwart Shieldmate shares identical printed text with Shieldroid (Taunt + Floating Memory), so this fixture is the same shape as shieldroid-floating-memory, exercising QueueMaterializeFloatingPaymentChoice's graveyard-payment path for a second, independent card rather than duplicating coverage. Stalwart Shieldmate is seeded directly into the graveyard, with no myMemory filler, and Lorraine, Wandering Warrior's 1-memory champion level-up is initiated from myMaterial-0; selecting myGraveyard-0 at the MZMULTICHOOSE pays the full cost and PAYFLOATING moves the card straight to myBanish. Taunt is a computed attack-declaration restriction with no stored counter or flag to assert and is out of scope here.

rulesClauses: Floating Memory (While paying for a memory cost, you may banish this card from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost.)
